parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const job = $('Job card').first().json, profile = $('HTTP /profile').first().json, reader = $('HTTP /reader').first().json; const card = Object.fromEntries(job.card.requirements.map(r => [r.req_id, r])); return { cv_id: profile.cv_id, requirements: job.card.requirements.map(r => ({ req_id: r.req_id, text: r.text, kind: r.kind, category: r.category, skill_terms: r.skill_terms || [], min_years: r.min_years ?? null })), results: $json.matches.map(m => ({ req_id: m.req_id, kind: card[m.req_id].kind, decision: m.decision, review_reasons: m.review_reasons, info_flags: m.info_flags, category: card[m.req_id].category, min_years: card[m.req_id].min_years, evidence_years: m.evidence_years, confidence: m.confidence ? m.confidence.normalized : null, judge: m.judge ? { verdict: m.judge.verdict, nli_probs: m.judge.nli_probs } : null })), pair_review_reasons: [...reader.review_reasons, ...profile.review_reasons, ...job.review_reasons] }; })()) }}

nodes.name: Bias Auditor
nodes.notes: Station 5 (T11): leakage flags + live identity-swap test (POST /bias); bias:swap_flip -> review

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const job = $('Job card').first().json, reader = $('HTTP /reader').first().json, bias = $('Bias Auditor').first().json, profile = $('HTTP /profile').first().json; const card = Object.fromEntries(job.card.requirements.map(r => [r.req_id, r])); const matches = $('Aggregate').first().json.matches; return { cv_id: profile.cv_id, job_title: job.card.title || null, decided_by: 'gate', requirements: matches.map(m => ({ req_id: m.req_id, kind: card[m.req_id].kind, text: card[m.req_id].text, decision: m.decision, quotes: (m.evidence || []).map(e => e.quote), judge: m.judge ? m.judge.verdict : null, review_reasons: m.review_reasons, skill_terms: card[m.req_id].skill_terms || [], min_years: card[m.req_id].min_years ?? null, evidence_years: m.evidence_years ?? null })), outcome: { outcome: $json.outcome, score: $json.score, rule: $json.rule, reasons: $json.reasons }, reader: { mode: reader.mode, review_reasons: reader.review_reasons }, bias: { review_reasons: bias.review_reasons, swap: bias.swap } }; })()) }}

nodes.name: Report Writer
nodes.notes: Station 7 (T12): Qwen3-4B plain writes the report, code checks it, template fallback (POST /report)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const r = $json, job = $('Job card').first().json; const card = Object.fromEntries(job.card.requirements.map(q => [q.req_id, q])); return { cv_id: r.cv_id, job_title: job.card.title || null, decided_by: 'human', requirements: r.requirements.map(q => ({ req_id: q.req_id, kind: q.kind, text: q.text, decision: q.decision, quotes: (q.quotes || []).map(e => e.quote), judge: q.judge ? q.judge.verdict : null, review_reasons: q.review_reasons, skill_terms: (card[q.req_id] || {}).skill_terms || [], min_years: (card[q.req_id] || {}).min_years ?? null, evidence_years: null })), outcome: { outcome: r.final_decision, score: r.score, rule: 'decided by a recruiter after review', reasons: [...(r.reasons || []), 'decided by a recruiter after review: ' + r.final_decision] }, reader: { mode: (r.reader || {}).mode, review_reasons: (r.reader || {}).review_reasons || [] }, bias: { review_reasons: (r.bias || {}).review_reasons || [], swap: (r.bias || {}).swap || {} } }; })()) }}
